title: A Bakery for the Summer
author: S. M. Dunmore
blurb: Beatrix Okonkwo, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
